answer: Admit through a proof-of-wait queue: each applicant's priority equals publicly verifiable time-in-queue, and any linkage found between queue entries resets every linked entry to zero. A farmer flooding the queue with clones only shares one timeline across them; the patient single applicant rises like an oasis out of the sand, each ember of seniority earned hour by hour, while a thousand linked clones keep restarting at the horizon and never arrive.
